map.：算法：三维欧氏距离 d = √((x2−x1)² + (y2−y1)² + (: : Algorithm: 3D Euclidean distance d = √((x2−x1)² + (y2−y1)² + (z2−z1)²), the natural 3D extension of the 2D Pythagorean theorem. Coordinates may be any real numbers and the distance is always non-negative.
map.三维距离 = √(二维平面距离² + 高度差²)；若 z 相同即退化为二维距离。: 3D distance = √(2D planar distance² + height difference²); if z is the same it degenerates to the 2D distance. It is essentially the Pythagorean theorem applied dimension by dimension.
map.可以，差值平方后负号消失，距离与坐标正负无关，只取决于相对位置。: Yes, after squaring the sign disappears, so distance is independent of coordinate signs and depends only on relative position.
